title: Underperformance: diagnosing it before deciding anything

videos.script: Renata has named the pattern to Marcos. Stuck without saying so. Estimates missed by weeks. A page that waited forty minutes. {{title}} What she does not know is why. {{why}} The easy conclusions are all there. He does not care. He is not good enough. Something at home. Each one leads to a different action, and two of them are unfair if wrong. {{guess}} This lesson is about the step between naming a problem and deciding anything. A sequence of questions that starts with the manager's own part. {{sequence}} And a conversation that opens with what the manager got wrong. {{conversation}} What Marcos says in it changes everything that follows. {{marcos}}
